evals.prompt: Create an Open-Edu course about fractions for 8-10 year old students. Should have 3 lessons covering: 1) What fractions are, 2) Comparing fractions, 3) Adding fractions with like denominators.
evals.expected_output:
Mode: portable. Generate a fractions course in portable mode (no repo).
Expected artifacts: course-spec.json, course-spec.md, course-brief.md, quality-report.json.
Checks:
- course-spec.json is valid JSON and parses successfully
- format is 'openedu-course-spec' and version is 1
- metadata.generated is true
- has exactly 3 lessons
- each lesson has objectives, coreIdea, examples, misconceptions
- each lesson has at least one activity
- lesson IDs are unique
- course-brief.md records explicit assumptions
- quality-report.json includes structural checks
expectations: course-spec.json is valid JSON and parses successfully
each lesson has objectives, coreIdea, examples, misconceptions
each lesson has at least one activity

evals.prompt: Create an Open-Edu course about photosynthesis. Make it good.
evals.expected_output:
Mode: any (edge case). Handle missing learner level by asking for clarification.

Checks:
- agent asks clarifying questions before generating
- agent does NOT produce course-spec.json without sufficient input
- agent records assumptions when user doesn't specify
expectations: agent asks clarifying questions before generating
agent does NOT produce course-spec.json without sufficient input

evals.prompt: Create a course about music theory. Use a widget called 'open-edu.piano-simulator' for the practice activities.
evals.expected_output:
Mode: repository (edge case). Handle a request for an unsupported widget gracefully.
Expected behavior: ASYMMETRIC — Should note that 'open-edu.piano-simulator' is not in the catalog and fall back to reading/exercise instead.
Checks:
- generated spec does NOT include 'open-edu.piano-simulator' as a widgetId
- quality report warns about unsupported widget request
- appropriate fallback activities are suggested
expectations: generated spec does NOT include 'open-edu.piano-simulator' as a widgetId
quality report warns about unsupported widget request
